title: 可移植的工具结果工件（简体中文）
text: 由 tool_result() 创建的每个结果都是 ellmer::ContentToolResult，包含三个刻意分离的通道： 工件是非 shinychat UI 的主要集成点。当官方构造函数可用时，codeagent 会通过 shinychat::tool_result_display() 投影生成 display；兼容后备仅用于已安装的旧版 shinychat。 该适配器可能包含 shinychat 特有的 HTML 和带框卡片行为，因此第三方宿主不应解析其中的展示 HTML。 即使工件缺失、格式错误、来自未来版本，或其种类尚未被宿主渲染，value 仍然可用。
code: ContentToolResult ├── value                         可移植的模型/UI 文本后备 ├── extra$codeagent$artifact      有版本、与 UI 无关的结构化数据 └── extra$display                 可选的 shinychat 展示适配器

title: 可移植的工具结果工件（简体中文）
text: 版本 1 工件具有以下稳定的外层结构和字段顺序： 典型载荷如下： 宿主应容忍额外载荷字段，并且只渲染自己明确支持的组合。
code: list(   schema  = "codeagent.tool-artifact",   version = 1L,   kind,   status,   icon,   title,   payload )

title: 可移植的工具结果工件（简体中文）
text: 从 ellmer 工具返回 tool_result()。它的第一个参数始终是可移植值；丰富字段只是附加信息。 codeagent 把可移植工件存入 extra$codeagent$artifact，并在 extra$display 中单独构造可选的 shinychat 适配器。安装的 shinychat 支持时，丰富结果会请求官方带框展示；这不会改变跨 UI 工件。
code: summarise_tool <- ellmer::tool(   function(group) {     result <- summarise_data(group)     codeagent::tool_result(       value = sprintf("Summary contains %d rows.", nrow(result)),       kind = "table",       title = "Grouped summary",       payload = list(df = result)     )   },   name = "Summarise",   description = "Summarise data by a group.",   arguments = list(     group = ellmer::type_string("Grouping variable.")   ) )

title: 可移植的工具结果工件（简体中文）
text: 无论输入是 ContentToolResult 对象还是流式事件，都应使用公开访问器。不要直接访问私有嵌套结构， 也不要解析 display HTML。 tool_result_artifact() 验证协议 schema 和外层结构。其默认值为 version = 1L；当 v1 消费者应回退到 文本时，它返回 NULL。version 参数可以包含一个或多个受支持的正整数版本。 tool_result_value() 会尽可能提取可移植文本。
code: render_result <- function(event_or_result) {   artifact <- codeagent::tool_result_artifact(event_or_result)    if (is.null(artifact)) {     return(render_text(codeagent::tool_result_value(event_or_result)))   }    switch(     artifact$kind,     table = render_table(artifact$payload$df),     image = render_images(artifact$payload$images),     code  = render_code(artifact$payload$text),     diff  = render_diff(artifact$payload),     error = render_error(artifact$payload$message),     render_text(codeagent::tool_result_value(event_or_result))   ) }

title: 可移植的工具结果工件（简体中文）
text: codeagent_stream() 和 codeagent_stream_async() 按以下严格且保持兼容性的字段顺序发送工具结果事件： artifact 追加在原有五个字段之后，从而保持位置兼容性。自定义 UI 通常只读取 artifact、value 和 is_error。display 字段是可选的 shinychat 展示数据。
code: list(   id,   name,   display,   value,   is_error,   artifact ) codeagent::codeagent_stream(   client,   "Run the summary tool",   on_tool_result = function(event) {     artifact <- codeagent::tool_result_artifact(event)     if (!is.null(artifact) && identical(artifact$kind, "table")) {       render_table(artifact$payload$df)     } else {       render_text(codeagent::tool_result_value(event))     }   } )

title: 可移植的工具结果工件（简体中文）
text: 有效的未来版本工件会在适配和流式传输中保持不变，但默认的 v1 访问器会拒绝它们： 支持多个已知版本的消费者可以显式传入它们，例如 version = c(1L, 2L)。传入 NULL 只会关闭消费者版本 过滤；schema 和外层结构验证仍然生效。这样，中间件可以在不破坏工件的前提下转发有效的未来版本， 而旧 UI 仍能可靠地回退到 tool_result_value(event)。UI 只有在实现了新版本契约后才应选择接受该版本。 适配期间，无版本的旧工件可以升级为 v1。格式错误的元数据绝不会被当作有效的未来协议：直接调用访问器会 返回 NULL，而适配过程可以合成一个基于 value 的有效 v1 工件，使可移植文本保持可用。
code: # 安全的 v1 渲染决策 artifact_v1 <- codeagent::tool_result_artifact(event)  # 仅用于协议检查或转发；不要渲染未知版本 artifact_any <- codeagent::tool_result_artifact(event, version = NULL)

title: 可移植的工具结果工件（简体中文）
text: 工件数据、外部 display 元数据和恢复的会话元数据都属于不可信输入。因此 codeagent 遵循以下规则： 格式错误或不受支持的工件会软失败到可移植的 value； 普通标题、载荷文本、Markdown 输入和字符 HTML 在浏览器渲染前会被转义，或被放入会自动转义的标签构造器； 只有显式的 htmltools::HTML、shiny.tag 或 shiny.tag.list 对象才能跨越可信 HTML 边界； kind = "error" 必然意味着 status = "error"，工具/提供商错误元数据也会强制错误状态，即使保留了 image 或 diff 这类丰富种类； 无关的 request、error、来源溯源和提供商元数据在适配后仍会保留； 格式错误的 display 选项会回退到基于有效工件的官方展示； 旧会话卡片只会在展示副本上升级，不会改变面向提供商的 value 或工具 request/result 标识符。 这些规则既适用于内置 Shiny UI，也适用于自定义消费者：UI 可以增强有效工件，但必须始终保留可移植值作为 安全的最终后备。

title: 可移植的工具结果工件（简体中文）
text: 对于现有宿主集成： 继续把 value 视为面向模型和最终后备的文本通道。 用 tool_result_artifact() 替代对 display$toolcard 或 display$right_output 的读取。 只渲染宿主明确支持的工件版本和种类。 其他所有情况都通过 tool_result_value() 回退。 只有在明确集成 shinychat 时才消费 display。 完整的后端回调契约见 vignette("backend-integration")。

text: Data Shield never sends raw rows DescribeData; bulk tool output registered high-entropy values withheld reaching LLM. Foreground Agent sub-chats inherit shield codeagent’s owned Agent path; raw btw_tool_agent_* delegators exposed, replies output-gated hooks parent results, shielded sidechains persisted. Cross-process BackgroundAgent//bg fail closed shield active. shield_describe(distributions=) defaults "" (category labels , counts); "" shows real per-category counts "dp" shows Laplace-noised counts drawn per-dataset dp_budget (default 5, dp_epsilon = 1 per exposure) silently degrades back ""-style output exhausted – numeric columns unaffected either mode (see Data Shield vignette DP continuous statistics separate, harder problem). Data Shield guards three edges model boundary. Edge 2 (tool traffic) scan_ingress/scan_egress layer . Edge 1 (everything user sends) input gate: scan_prompt() detects registered protected value pasted message (value_match) PII/token shapes (regex) default redacts matched spans, keeping rest user’s text (on_fail = "redact"/"block"/"ask"; pass on_progress drive “scanning data safety…” UI). input gate runs input, just typed text: scans typed text text-bearing attachments, exposes optional data_shield_image_scanner hook image attachments (default NULL = images scanned; host may inject OCR/VLM scanner). ready-made OCR scanner ships data_shield_ocr_scanner(shield) (opt-; uses optional tesseract Suggests dep degrades pass absent). runs automatically UserPromptSubmit point entry paths — agent loop (CLI) Shiny stream — shield active. kept separate UserPromptSubmit hook, may block append context — matching Claude Code — never rewrites user’s input; shield redacts. Edge 3 (model’s reply back user) output gate: .output_gate_scan() / DataShield$scan_response() scan finalized reply detectors, catching protected value model reproduced (e.g. inferred tool output) even user’s input clean. CLI redacts reply place; shield active Shiny/CLI streaming paths buffer reply, scan , show (possibly redacted) text — nothing reaches browser output gate run (plaintext-- warning). Configure via data_shield_response_on_fail data_shield_output_scanners. gates take configurable scanner list (data_shield_input_scanners / data_shield_output_scanners, default c("value_match", "regex"), secure--default): host may drop detector, e.g. c("value_match") keeps registered-value matching skips PII regex. Protected-data schema system prompt (querychat-style): shield active, registered dataset’s filtered schema (identifier values suppressed, rare categories hidden — output DescribeData produces) injected system prompt, model knows protected data exists without calling tool first (longer fabricates column names/dims). DescribeData tool remains live -demand fallback. Data registered client built initial prompt; data uploaded runtime, call refresh_data_shield_context(client) register_data() rebuild system prompt (preserves history, one-time cache miss). register_data() auto-refresh — shield stays decoupled Chat. shield_egress(max_rows = 0) retains raw tabular line bulk output detected; scalar/status/model-summary output still passes. shield_regex() handles unregistered PII/secrets; shield_ingress() scans every tool’s arguments central permission gate can block request approval execution (built-rules host-extensible: patterns= name matching built-replaces , new name adds ). shield_tool_policy() provides exact/glob per-tool scan/bypass/deny rules; Shield bypass audited never bypasses separate permission gate. shield_sandbox() preserves project/temp rwx process execution default, portable path policy blocks project-external symlink-escaped paths; backend="auto" currently reports/falls back policy unless full OS adapter available. shield_reviewer() optional internal rail: fresh, tool-less ellmer Chat reviews deterministically sanitized code/arguments; remote reviewers never receive raw data/output, missing/failed reviewers follow configurable ask/block fail-closed policy. See full Data Shield parameter reference. Optional egress approval keeps raw disabled unless explicitly requested: callback, timeout, error, invalid choice defaults redact. -memory audit log records non-sensitive decision metadata (strategy, action, reason label, count, tool/id), never matched values raw results: Safe reference assets protected datasets use separate type/access axes: kind says asset ; llm_access says may enter/leave LLM. Raw egress never default requires provenance (shield$trusted_result()), reason, expiry/session scope, audit. audit_code_tool(shield, project_root) opt-AuditCode tool main-loop model can call vet block R code running : deterministically extracts referenced paths AST, enforces -project source-file whitelist code (never delegated model), reads whitelisted files, — shield — routes vetted text shield_reviewer() rail. returns risk metadata (refs, blocked , reviewer verdict), never file contents, grants read/write/shell capability. Host wires (e.g. sandbox disabled) model can self-audit external references. shield_preset_strict(), shield_preset_balanced(), shield_preset_clinical() ready-made strategy combinations codeagent_client(data_shield = ...) — three templates documented vignette("data-shield")’s “combination safety” matrix, callable functions instead copy-pasted code:

SESSION_END           – agent loop terminates (reason) POST_COMPACT          – context compaction completes STOP_FAILURE          – loop terminates error NOTIFICATION          – Generic user-facing notification TASK_CREATED          – task created (TaskCreate tool) TASK_COMPLETED        – task transitions completed WORKTREE_CREATE       – sub-agent git worktree created WORKTREE_REMOVE       – sub-agent git worktree removed INSTRUCTIONS_LOADED   – CLAUDE.md instruction file loaded FILE_CHANGED          – Filesystem change cwd (Shiny ) CONFIG_CHANGE         – settings file change (Shiny ) following Claude Code events defined parity live trigger codeagent (never fire); see inline notes: ELICITATION / ELICITATION_RESULT – need MCP elicitation (mcptools lacks ) TEAMMATE_IDLE         – codeagent teams one-shot mirai workers (idle state) SETUP                 – init/maintenance lifecycle phase CWD_CHANGED           – run-time cwd-change behaviour

title: Context Compaction System — compaction
text: Four-level context compaction mirroring Claude Code's design. L1 MicroCompact/Snip: replace old tool results placeholder L2 Session Memory: incremental summary (10K-40K tokens retained) L3 Full Compaction: fork agent generates 9-section structured summary L4 PTL Fallback: drop oldest turns 413/prompt_too_long errors Trigger threshold: model_limit - 20000 - 13000 tokens (e.g. 167K 200K model). Circuit breaker: 3 consecutive failures silence compaction attempts.

what: Input Gate — the edge-1 counterpart of the tool gate — input_gate
title: Input Gate — the edge-1 counterpart of the tool gate — input_gate
text: tool gate (R/tools_gate.R) guards edge 2 (tool traffic) wrapping ellmer's on_tool_request / tool functions. input gate guards edge 1: everything user sends reaches model — typed text attachments (text-bearing content, images). Unlike tool gate ellmer chat-level hook attach (user input handled inside agent_loop / Shiny stream, inside Chat object), input gate function entry points call UserPromptSubmit point. Two consumers run edge, order (mirroring tool gate's hooks--shield layering), kept SEPARATE systems: hooks run_user_prompt_submit() – aligns Claude Code's UserPromptSubmit; may block append context, NEVER redacts (handled agent_loop directly). Data Shield scan_prompt() – shield's confidentiality scan; MAY redact (protected values / PII user pasted ). file wires second consumer. Input types handled (see .input_gate_scan): text (typed message)        -> scan_prompt; redact/block/ask. text-bearing attachment     -> extract text, scan; redacted place (Content immutable) hit fails safe block. image attachment            -> optional image_scanner hook (default NULL = blind spot, passed ). Host may inject scanner (OCR / VLM) returning decision.

text: Lossless mid-conversation model switching. Pure-R harness functions usable CLI Shiny app. Conversation history (including tool requests/results) preserved across switch. what: Output Gate — the edge-3 counterpart of the input gate — output_gate
title: Output Gate — the edge-3 counterpart of the input gate — output_gate
text: Data Shield guards three edges /model: edge 1 input gate (R/input_gate.R): user input model. edge 2 tool gate (R/tools_gate.R): tool traffic /model. edge 3 output gate (file): model's final reply reaches user. output gate closes last confidentiality gap: model may reproduce protected value inferred tool output (edge-2 aggregate shield let ) even user's input clean. Symmetric input gate, reuses shield's scan_response() (thin wrapper scan_prompt() — identical value_match + PII detectors, audited edge = "response"). Streaming behaviour (kiro round-2/4): shield active, Shiny CLI streaming paths buffer reply, run output gate finished text, emit (possibly redacted) reply – nothing reaches browser gate run (plaintext--warning). ERROR path gated : partial reply scanned leaves via return value, raw error string surfaced. Without shield, streaming renders token--token (zero cost). CLI non-streaming path holds full response redacts returning.

Portable sandbox policy: new shield_sandbox() keeps project/session-temp rwx process execution default central gate validates explicit path arguments project/protected/temp roots, follows real paths reject symlink escape, enforces per-root r/rw/rwx, can deny network/exec capabilities. backend="auto" honestly falls back policy (blocks required mode) full OS process adapter yet wired; coverage/audit report fallback. btw file tools also covered (cwd guard permits symlink escape), btw RunR treated OS sandbox. Per-tool/agent Shield policy: new shield_tool_policy() supports exact *-glob rules scan (default), explicit audited bypass, deny independently execution, ingress egress. Trusted tools KMPlot may bypass egress retaining ingress scans; deny blocks execution. Shield bypass never bypasses separate central permission gate. Data Asset Policy separates asset (kind: dataset/spec/ document/synthetic) LLM may see (llm_access: prompt/egress none/schema/scan/raw). Kind-specific defaults keep datasets schema-allowing specs/synthetic prompt content; egress never defaults raw. Raw access requires reason, session-scoped optional expiry, audited, requires explicit provenance via $trusted_result(). Synthetic/raw always runs baseline PII/secret regex; spec/raw may explicitly disable . Non-sensitive Data Shield audit log: every blocked/asked ingress decision redacted/blocked egress event records timestamp, edge, tool name/call id, strategy, action, reason label, match count score owning R6 instance. Raw tool arguments/results, matched values, span text, rows hashes never stored. Use $audit(limit=), $clear_audit(), $coverage()$audit_events; audit_max bounds memory oldest-first eviction. Universal Data Shield ingress scanning: new shield_ingress() scans arguments every native/btw/MCP/host tool inside single central permission gate execution. High-confidence R/Python/Bash serialization, encoded output, network exfiltration, shell data-file display, registered-data preview calls, custom PCRE rules may block force existing ask_fn approval UI. Read-/unknown tools longer bypass Shield-forced ask; without Shield, permission behaviour unchanged. Composable egress scanners: DataShield now executes ordered scanner pipeline (list order = execution order) supports runtime $add_scanner(name, fn). New shield_regex() redacts blocks unregistered email, phone-like values, common API-token prefixes, 18-character identity numbers, custom named PCRE patterns. Scanner contracts validated fail closed; custom S7 Python dependency introduced. Data Shield recursively covers foreground sub-agents: synchronous concurrent Agent sub-chats inherit parent DataShield first model request, uninstrumented btw/custom-agent delegation skipped. BackgroundAgent /bg fail closed shield active separate mirai process safely inherit session’s R6/index yet. Multi-user Shiny isolation: codeagent_app(client_factory = function(session) ...) now creates fresh CodeagentClient/Chat inside every Shiny session; -client default uses safe path automatically. Passing pre-built client remains explicitly single-user compatibility path. Data Shield protected values live session/thread-owned DataShield R6 may shared deliberately without package-global index. Data Shield P0/P0.5/P1 (opt-, default ) now single stateful DataShield R6 engine. easy data_shield=list(shield_*()) form creates private R6; pass explicit DataShield$new() register uploads share policy across selected chats. shield$install(chat) wraps tool results; shield$register_data() builds high-entropy value indexes; shield$describe() powers automatically installed strict DescribeData tool. Bulk rows targeted protected values withheld; metadata exposes distributions, counts, raw rows, free-text examples. Scanner specs remain plain R functions/lists (custom S7). Backend permission gate host tools: new exported install_permission_gate(chat, permission_mode, rules, tools, ask_fn, tool_meta) lets harness-client (register_tools = FALSE) put central permission gate host-attached tools (gate otherwise installed .register_all_tools()). gate now also passes tool-call id ask_fns accept (ask_fn(name, input, id = NULL)), hosts can match approval prompt on_tool_request preview; legacy (name, input) ask_fns unchanged. Backend embedding (Contract v1): documented, stable surface hosting codeagent backend engine. New exported register_tool_meta(name, capability) lets host apps declare custom tool’s capability (read/write/exec/net) central permission gate governs (undeclared tool previously defaulted read allowed ungated). New exported tool_result(value, kind, payload) builds typed display card (text/table/image/code/diff/error) reaches on_tool_result$display callback Shiny app. Adds backend-integration vignette + reference example (inst/examples/backend_integration_demo.R) + contract guard test. Concurrent sub-agents (opt-via settings$async_subagents, default ): Agent tool can run asynchronously multiple sub-agent delegations requested single turn execute concurrently (via ellmer’s tool_mode = "concurrent") async streaming paths (CLI REPL / Shiny app). Sync one-shot codeagent() transparently falls back sequential sub-agents, since async (promise-returning) tools invalid Chat$chat(). Also adopts ellmer 0.4.2 (set_model(), chat_posit()). Background sub-agents (opt-via settings$background_agents, default ; requires mirai): new BackgroundAgent tool delegates task fire--forget sub-agent running mirai daemon returns immediately (non-blocking). result polled surfaced back model later turn via system reminder, mirroring Claude Code’s async agents. Users can also spawn inspect background agents directly /bg <task> /bgstatus slash commands (REPL Shiny).

title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: First public release. codeagent R-native reimplementation command-line coding agent, built ellmer btw. provides agent harness (loop, tools, permissions, compaction, hooks, skills) plus CLI REPL shiny user interface.

what: Model tier env var rename — breaking changes
title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: Three environment variables renamed remove vendor-specific names. Update .Renviron / settings.json env block accordingly: Tier aliases used /model codeagent.md also changed: "sonnet" → "main", "opus" → "heavy", "haiku" → "fast". CODEAGENT_MODEL now serves dual purpose: sets default model "main" tier alias (previously CODEAGENT_MODEL CODEAGENT_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL separate; now merged).

what: CLI/ink unified entry point — breaking changes (plan #20)
title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: Default permission mode now "default" across entry points (CLI, Shiny, ink). Previously CLI subcommands defaulted "bypass". Write operations (file edits, shell commands) now prompt approval unless explicitly opt bypass mode. -y / --yolo — new global flag CLI enables bypass mode (skips permission prompts). Equivalent Claude Code’s --dangerously-skip-permissions. Short-hand: -y. codeagent without subcommand now starts interactive REPL directly (equivalent codeagent chat). Previously subcommand required. -p / --print-mode — new flag one-shot non-interactive output. codeagent "query" codeagent -p "query" runs single query exits. -m now means --model (breaking). old -m/--mode alias removed. Use -y/--yolo bypass mode instead. ink_ui() gains yolo = FALSE parameter. TRUE, sets INK_YOLO=1 codeagent backend runs bypass mode. inkai terminal command also accepts -y/--yolo. INK_YOLO env var — set "1" enable bypass mode ink launching inkai command directly: INK_YOLO=1 inkai codeagent. codeagent_app(permission_mode = "default") unchanged — Shiny already correct; pass permission_mode = "bypass" explicitly needed. R/cli_dispatch.R — new internal helpers .ca_resolve_mode() .ca_dispatch() expose CLI dispatch logic testable pure functions.
code: codeagent -y           # bypass REPL codeagent app -y       # bypass Shiny app codeagent run "q" -y   # bypass one-shot query ink_ui("codeagent", yolo = TRUE)   # bypass # or from terminal: inkai codeagent -y                 # bypass

title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: codeagent_stream_async() — new exported function. Streams one agent turn asynchronously (coro::async promise). Runs full turn pipeline (compaction, system-reminder injection, session save, cost tracking via get_cost(include="last")). Fires typed callbacks: on_delta, on_thinking, on_tool_request (pre-gate, stream chunk), on_tool_result (typed display contract .adapt_tool_result()), on_error, on_usage. Supports stream_controller cancellation tool_mode concurrent tool execution. codeagent_stream() — synchronous wrapper around codeagent_stream_async() using later::run_now() pump event loop. Handles Ctrl+C gracefully (cancels stream via stream_controller, re-throw interrupt condition). Intended CLI ink frontends. Turn pipeline helpers (R/turn_pipeline.R, internal): .turn_setup() consolidates compaction + resource replacement + system-reminder injection one call. .turn_teardown() consolidates session save + usage + cost_last. now shared console, Shiny, ink. Shiny system-reminder injection fixed. server_chat.R’s stream_task now injects <system-reminder> block (date/iteration/cwd/memory) every turn, matching behaviour console REPL agent_loop(). Console Ctrl+C repair. codeagent_console() now creates stream_controller per turn catches interrupt conditions, cancelling stream gracefully. Previously Ctrl+C corrupt chat state. Callback deduplication. .register_repl_tool_callbacks() now guarded .chat_once() prevent stacking display callbacks codeagent_console() called chat object. .patch_interrupted_chat() retired. Removed call sites. ellmer 0.4.0+ (#840) 0.4.1+ (#643) handle orphaned tool requests AssistantPartialTurn automatically. inkAssistantUI tool cards upgraded. ink_reply_stream() now calls codeagent_stream() available (full turn pipeline + display contract). on_tool_result receives rich display field (title/kind/payload) instead plain string. ink_server() initialises per-session CompactionController / ContentReplacementState / session_id turns properly managed.

title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: Task DAG. team_coordinate() gains blocked_by — task dependencies given 1-based index. task claimed blockers done, workers respect ordering still parallelising independent tasks. Cyclic graphs rejected front. shared board’s claim now dependency-aware atomic (BEGIN IMMEDIATE). Worktree isolation + crash recovery. worktree = TRUE runs worker git worktree; board_reclaim_stale() (wired worker loop) resets crashed worker’s timed-task back pending dependents never blocked forever. Event-driven board. board_watch() (built watcher package) reacts board changes without polling, powering event-driven coordinator / live board view (falls back polling watcher unavailable). LLM-lead coordinator. team_lead(goal, max_rounds =) faithfully ports Claude Code’s COORDINATOR_MODE: lead model decomposes goal task DAG, work-stealing team runs , lead reviews results either finishes adds follow-round (bounded loop; decompose/review/coordinate steps injectable testing). Live dashboard. team_dashboard(db_path) standalone Shiny app monitors running team’s board real time — task table (coloured status), progress bar, inter-agent message log.

title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: Instant startup. UI shell now renders immediately; slower tool + skill registration runs background behind prominent “Initializing codeagent…” overlay, chat input gated completes. Pass bare ellmer::Chat codeagent_app() lazy path. Skill metadata disk cache. list_skills_meta() now caches parsed skill metadata disk (<config>/cache/skills/, keyed cwd + SKILL.md mtime/count signature), slash typeahead skill tool near-instant every launch first (disk hit skips ~20s directory scan). cache self-invalidates SKILL.md changes skill added/removed. Single-file viewer. Clicking file Files tree now opens one static, scrollable “File” tab (code / Markdown / image / CSV) filename header close button, replacing old per-file tabs overflow cover tab strip.

title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: keyring integration (R/keyring.R): Optional API key storage via OS credential store (keyring package). setup.R offers keyring alternative ~/.Renviron backend available. Includes .keyring_available() (session-cached probe), .keyring_store_key() graceful fallback ~/.Renviron, .keyring_get_key(). headless/server environments keyring backend probe returns FALSE functions degrade silently existing ~/.Renviron path. webfakes agent integration tests (tests/testthat/test-webfakes-agent.R): 12 tests mock LLM API endpoint webfakes, exercising full agent loop — tool dispatch (Read, Write, Bash), permission gate (bypass vs plan), error recovery (HTTP 500), skill invocation — without hitting real LLM. Explicit tool names: bash_tool(), read_tool(), write_tool(), edit_tool(), multi_edit_tool(), glob_tool(), grep_tool(), ls_tool() now pass name= ellmer::tool() model can refer tools canonical names (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, Glob, Grep, LS).

title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: Agentic loop (agent_loop()) max-turns, token budget, verification, error recovery (prompt--long, rate-limit, network, auth handling). Seven-mode permission system: default, plan, accept_edits, bypass, dont_ask, auto, bubble (sub-agent decisions bubble parent). Fine-grained rules match tool arguments (e.g. Bash(npm run test *)). Twelve-event hook system covering tool, permission, message, lifecycle events, configurable declaratively settings.json. Five-level context compaction (snip, session memory, full summary, prompt fallback, context collapse). System prompt tone, task, convention, tool-use, R-specific guidance.

title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: Core tools: Bash, Read, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, Glob, Grep, LS. RunR executes R code behind permission gate; sandboxing enabled runs isolated callr subprocess scrubbed environment (secrets hidden), .Renviron reload, wall-clock timeout. btw tool groups (docs, git, pkg, env, etc.), web fetch search, notebook tools, task persistent-todo tools. Optional codebase retrieval via ragnar (vector + keyword search).

title: codeagent 0.1.0
text: Sub-agents via agent_tool(), optional git-worktree isolation persistent “sidechain” sessions. Parallel teams: team_run() (fixed fan-) team_coordinate() (work-stealing shared SQLite board inter-agent messaging), capped container’s CPU quota via parallelly. Plan-mode tools let model enter exit read-planning mid-turn.

text: Sessions saved JSONL lossless tool-call preservation; fork, rename, tag, resume, rewind (truncate_chat_turns() / /rewind). Model switching mid-conversation (switch_model()), lossless possible.
